text: The blacksmith has sent some strange armour to our quartermaster. It seems to breathe softly, and when someone comes close it stirs and sniffs at them. The blacksmith says that to complete it, we must bathe it in the blood of many enemies. We should fulfil his request on our journey, my lord. Perhaps it will prove useful to us.

My lord, the blacksmith sends us some strange armour again. A strange shape that seems forged from chains and scraps of troll skin appears before you. "This armour fills anyone who comes near it with dread." The quartermaster continues: "He told us that we must kill enemies with this armour nearby so it can take their souls. We should take it on our travels to finish it, my lord."

My lord, the blacksmith sends us an unfinished sword this time. He wishes us to slay Northmen or Chaos daemons with it, to imbue it with the spirit of cold. The blade looks more like a shard of solid glass than steel. Just looking at it sends an icy shiver down your spine. The quartermaster continues: "He told us the blade will be complete once enough enemies have fallen to it. We should take it on our travels to finish it, my lord."

The Tavern Keepers' Guild has put a price on a lord seen near one of its Taverns, and we have taken the contract. Hunt the lord down and beat their army before the deadline.\\n\\nSuccess: our deposit comes back with the Guild's reward.\\nFailure, or dropping the contract: the deposit is lost, and every Tavern of the Guild charges us a quarter more for 10 turns.
